ideas.name: a narrow channel: the hour's range under 4 two-minute ATRs
ideas.why: a breakout from compression releases orders stacked at both edges; a wide channel has spent the move

ideas.name: a tested level: 3+ bars within 0.25 ATR of it in the last hour
ideas.why: a level touched again and again collects stops behind it; breaking it releases them

ideas.name: a fresh push: price pulled back 1 ATR in the last hour
ideas.why: a breakout after a reset has new buyers; one in a grinding trend is the last of them

ideas.name: breakout volume twice the last hour's average
ideas.why: a level broken on heavy volume is absorbed supply; on light volume it is a few stops

ideas.name: the hour's efficiency ratio 0.3 or more
ideas.why: an orderly trend (net move over path) breaks out cleanly; chop breaks out and back

ideas.name: not extended: under 1 ADR from the session's opposite extreme
ideas.why: a breakout already a full day's range from the day's low (high) is late

ideas.name: no losing trade in the last 30 minutes
ideas.why: a fresh failure says the market is rotating right now; the next break meets the same flow

ideas.name: the 15-minute trend agrees (its EMA 20)
ideas.why: a slower trend the breakout's way is the bigger flow behind it
